image_description: A close-up, vertical shot of a pelican (likely an Australian Pelican or similar species) floating on green water. The bird has white plumage on its head and neck, transitioning to black and grey mottled feathers on its back and wings. It features a very long, pale pinkish bill with a large gular pouch. The background is a smooth, out-of-focus teal/green water surface.

The transition where the white neck meets the dark body feathers is somewhat indistinct and blurry, lacking sharp anatomical definition, potentially indicating slight fusion or softness in generation.
